hero.heading: Hi 👋 I'm Krishna and I like building scalable ideas.

journeyIntro.title: My Journey
journeyIntro.description: This is a glimpse into my path— from foundational engineering to building high-performance enterprise systems, microservices, and design systems. It’s a story of growth, architecture, and continuous learning.

body.text: Leading full-stack engineering and architecture for mission-critical enterprise platforms across Financial Reconciliation, Loan Decisioning, Multi-tenant HRMS, CAD Project Management, and Insurance.

body.title: # Architecture & Core Engineering
items: Designed secure multi-tenant architectures with UUID-based data isolation and microservices using Docker, RabbitMQ, Redis, Kafka, and Node-RED.
Built a Tauri + Rust repository graph system to visualize code/context relationships and reduce LLM token usage and context-window consumption.
Engineered the Loan Rule Engine: automated sequential document extraction in Rust and FastAPI BRE-CRE multi-bank loan recommendations.
Built high-throughput Kafka-based Reconciliation platform with CQRS, event sourcing, and a Rust Excel comparison engine with full audit traceability.
Developed CAD Doctor: a cost-effective 2D CAD platform with Rust PDF properties parsing and URN-based dynamic routing.

body.text: Worked as a full-time UI/UX Designer for multiple brands across Tarun CMA, CMKCA, and Innovixinfinite, focusing on responsive, accessible, and user-centric web applications.

body.title: # Design Leadership & Systems
items: Designed wireframes, interactive prototypes, landing pages, dashboards, and admin panels using Figma.
Created and maintained scalable design systems, token mappings, and typography hierarchies.
Improved engagement and conversion through intuitive UI/UX flows and heuristic optimization.
Collaborated closely with development teams to deliver pixel-perfect responsive designs across desktop and mobile.

body.text: Supported design and development tasks during early-stage web application projects, gaining hands-on experience bridging JavaScript and TypeScript with full-stack implementation.
